Done with the other engineer over about 4 months, jointly implementing the integrations plus data migration runbooks, automation, validation, and support tooling the cutover required at the time. The in-house systems stayed fully in service until the new target platform was completely set up for everyone, so day-to-day floor operations continued without interruption. The cooperative made the switch to eliminate the recurring cost of maintaining these internal systems in-house.

cards.question: Describe a challenge you faced.

headline.text: I migrated in-house systems with the other engineer while day-to-day floor operations continued without interruption.

quotes.quote: In my final months there, migrated the cooperative's in-house inventory/repair-planning and equipment check-in/check-out tracking systems, with all of their archived history, to a unified third-party service-desk and asset-tracking platform. Done with the other engineer over about 4 months, jointly implementing the integrations plus data migration runbooks, automation, validation, and support tooling the cutover required at the time. The in-house systems stayed fully in service until the new target platform was completely set up for everyone, so day-to-day floor operations continued without interruption. The cooperative made the switch to eliminate the recurring cost of maintaining these internal systems in-house.
